name: DEMO 01 booking: new client books women's haircut
user_prompt: You are Maya Patel, a new client. You want a women's haircut this Saturday, any time in the morning. When offered times, pick the first one. Give your mobile as 631-555-0142 and email maya.patel@example.com. Confirm when asked.
metrics: The agent checked availability before offering times.
The agent only offered times returned by the availability tool.
The agent did not ask for any detail the caller had already given.
The agent confirmed the booking details only once and did not repeat details the caller had already confirmed.
The agent confirmed the service, stylist Emma, day, and time and got a yes before calling book_womens_haircut.
The agent said the appointment was booked only after the booking tool succeeded.

name: DEMO 02 booking: rejects first options, corrects email
user_prompt: You are Chris Romano. You want a blowout. Say none of the first times offered work and ask for Sunday instead; accept a Sunday time. Give email chris.romano@example.com and mobile 631-555-0199, then right away say 'sorry, the email is actually c.romano@example.com'.
metrics: The agent offered alternative times after the caller rejected the first options.
The agent used the corrected email c.romano@example.com when booking.
The agent called book_blowout only after the caller confirmed.

name: DEMO 03 booking: no availability
user_prompt: You are Dana Whitfield. You want balayage this week. Accept whatever the agent suggests next. Your number is 631-555-0177.
metrics: The agent did not invent any appointment times.
The agent offered another option such as a different date or taking a message for the team.
The agent did not claim an appointment was booked.

name: DEMO 04 booking: booking tool error
user_prompt: You are Priya Shah. Book a men's haircut for your husband Raj Shah, first time offered. Email raj.shah@example.com, mobile 631-555-0133. Confirm when asked.
metrics: After the booking tool returned an error, the agent did not say the appointment was booked.
The agent apologised and offered a fallback such as taking a message or trying another way.
The agent booked under the guest's name Raj Shah rather than the caller's name.

name: DEMO 05 reschedule: balayage moved
user_prompt: You are Jordan Lee. You have a balayage booked and need to move it to next week. Your booking email is jordan.lee@example.com. Pick the first new time offered and confirm.
metrics: The agent asked for the booking email and called find_booking.
The agent read back the existing balayage appointment and confirmed it was the right one.
The agent checked availability with check_balayage before offering new times.
The agent called reschedule_booking with booking_uid demo-uid-balayage-1 after the caller confirmed.

name: DEMO 06 cancel: short notice, no fee
user_prompt: You are Jordan Lee (jordan.lee@example.com). You want to cancel your balayage. If the agent offers to reschedule, politely decline. Then confirm the cancellation.
metrics: If the caller had not already declined rescheduling, the agent offered it once before cancelling.
The agent mentioned the 24-hour notice request kindly.
The agent did not say any cancellation fee would be charged.
The agent called cancel_booking only after the caller confirmed.

name: DEMO 07 cancel: booking not found
user_prompt: You are Sam Ortiz (sam.ortiz@example.com). You want to cancel an appointment you think is on Friday. When the agent can't find it, agree to leave a message. Your number is 631-555-0188.
metrics: The agent did not claim to cancel anything.
The agent offered to take a message for the salon team.
The agent said the team would follow up within one business day.

name: DEMO 08 FAQ: hours, location, parking
user_prompt: You are a curious caller. Ask what the hours are on Monday and Sunday, what the address is, and whether there's parking. Then say thanks and goodbye.
metrics: The agent said the salon is closed on Mondays and open Sunday 10 AM to 4 PM.
The agent did not invent a street address or phone number.
The agent said the salon team can confirm parking details.

name: DEMO 09 FAQ: prices and unknown question
user_prompt: Ask how much balayage costs and how long it takes. Then ask whether they sell gift cards. Then say goodbye.
metrics: The agent said balayage starts from $225 and takes about 3 hours.
The agent did not make up an answer about gift cards and offered that the team can confirm or take a message.

name: DEMO 10 after hours: message for the team
user_prompt: You are Elena Russo calling late on a Monday evening. You want to speak to someone about a wedding party booking for five people. Your number is the one you're calling from. Don't book anything.
metrics: The agent said the salon is currently closed.
The agent collected the caller's name, confirmed the callback number, and got the reason.
The agent called save_message.
The agent said the salon team will follow up within one business day.

name: DEMO 11 after hours: still books
user_prompt: You are Taylor Brooks calling on a Monday night. You want a deep conditioning treatment this Saturday. Take the first time. Email taylor.brooks@example.com, mobile 631-555-0166. Confirm.
metrics: The agent mentioned the salon is closed but still offered to book.
The agent called check_deep_conditioning and then book_deep_conditioning after confirmation.

name: DEMO 12 stylist: Emma for highlights
user_prompt: You are Lauren Kim, a new client. Ask to book full highlights with Emma. When the agent explains who does highlights, happily accept that stylist. If a consultation is suggested, say no thanks. Take the first time offered. Email lauren.kim@example.com, mobile 631-555-0111. Confirm once, then end the call politely.
metrics: The agent told the caller that Olivia does full highlights.
The agent did not ask the caller to repeat or re-confirm contact details they had already given.
The agent booked with book_full_highlights after confirmation.

name: DEMO 13 reaction after service: urgent message
user_prompt: You are Nina Gold. You had colour done two days ago and your scalp is itchy and red. You want the owner to call you. Number 631-555-0155.
metrics: The agent suggested seeing a pharmacist or doctor and did not diagnose.
The agent took a message and called save_message with urgency urgent.
The agent did not promise a refund or a free fix.

name: DEMO 14 brevity: no repeated confirmations
user_prompt: You are Anthony Sharma. Say 'can I book an appointment'. When asked, say 'men's haircut'. Then 'Saturday'. Pick the latest time offered. Give everything in one go when asked: Anthony Sharma, 631-555-0124, anthony.sharma@example.com. Answer every confirmation with just 'yeah'. When asked if there's anything else, say 'no, that's it, bye'. If the agent asks you to confirm something you already confirmed, say 'yes, I said that' once, then just answer normally.
metrics: The agent never asked the caller to confirm the same detail twice.
The agent never said anything about reference text, knowledge, or instructions.
Each agent reply was at most two sentences.
The agent offered at most two or three times rather than reading out a long range, and only times the tool returned.
The agent called book_mens_haircut after the first yes.
